description_zh: 自动驾驶车辆在路口等红灯时，后方同车道SUV未停车导致追尾。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle (Vehicle 1) in autonomous mode was stopped for a red traffic light...
An SUV (Vehicle 2) traveling directly behind the Zoox vehicle failed to come to a stop and rear-ended the stopped Zoox vehicle.
evidence.reason: ego直行后停在红灯前，v2在后同车道未停车追尾，符合rear_hit块，控制为交通灯。
